boundary: A one-time, unauthenticated Bing HTML snapshot. It is not a global rank report, indexing proof, causal impact finding, or AI-answer measurement. Results may vary by location, time, language, personalization, and engine changes.

observations.collection_method: Unauthenticated HTTP request to Bing search with setlang=en-US; first ten parsed organic result titles per query.
observations.result: No SHAR Production, sharprod.com, or a verified SHAR external representation appeared in the first ten parsed organic result titles for any of the three exact-brand queries.
observations.dominant_ambiguity: Results were dominated by unrelated Shar fantasy/game/entity pages and other unrelated results.
observations.actionable_implication: External exact-name-and-domain references and independent authority signals remain higher priority than additional SHAR-controlled URLs. No public-site change follows from this measurement.
